company_stage: large public semiconductor and computing company

culture_principles.name: Public mission and customer-impact alignment
culture_principles.description: AMD fit should connect work to the company outcomes and users described in cited public sources.

culture_principles.name: Evidence-backed execution
culture_principles.description: Strong answers should show practical judgment, clear tradeoffs, ownership, and outcomes rather than generic enthusiasm.

culture_principles.name: Outcome-linked technical ambition
culture_principles.description: Work is framed around product performance, power efficiency, and customer workloads rather than around activity volume; strong candidates connect engineering choices to those outcomes.

culture_principles.name: Co-design across silicon, software, and platform
culture_principles.description: Public material describes products that depend on hardware, software, and platform teams converging on one roadmap, so cross-team coordination is a visible part of the work.

culture_principles.name: Measured evidence over enthusiasm
culture_principles.description: Public-safe signals reward answers that cite benchmarks, validation results, or shipped outcomes instead of general excitement about the company or the AI market.

hiring_signals.signal: Connects decisions to the users, customers, products, or markets named in public company sources.
Uses concrete examples to show ownership, learning, and measurable improvement.
Explains a concrete tradeoff across performance, power, cost, and schedule using measured or reproducible evidence.
Describes coordinating a change across hardware, software, and validation groups and names the mechanism that kept them aligned.
Shows ownership of a difficult technical problem through to a shipped product, benchmark result, or documented customer outcome.

anti_signals.anti_signal: Generic admiration for the company without a concrete role, customer, product, or business mechanism.
anti_signals.risk_reason: Public lens usage should stay grounded in cited source signals and role-relevant evidence.

anti_signals.anti_signal: Enthusiasm about AI accelerators with no concrete engineering mechanism, measurement approach, or role-relevant tradeoff.
anti_signals.risk_reason: Public source signals are product- and roadmap-level; without a mechanism the answer cannot be evaluated against them.

anti_signals.anti_signal: Claims about AMD's internal culture, interview bar, or hiring process presented as established fact.
anti_signals.risk_reason: The lens is built only from public-safe source metadata and does not represent an official AMD hiring standard.

interview_patterns.pattern: Use cited public source signals to test role-relevant judgment, ownership, communication, and impact.

honest_limits: This is a lightweight public-source lens and does not represent an official AMD hiring standard.
It contains source metadata and non-verbatim public-safe signals only.
Role, team, seniority, location, and hiring manager can materially change interview emphasis.
This lens requires deeper multi-source validation before being promoted to FULLY_DISTILLED.
